data.name: Devapriya
data.gender_notes: Devapriya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ (God) and ‘Priya’ (Delight). It is a name signifying the divine pleasure and happiness that the deity brings into one's life. The name Devapriya carries the meaning “God's delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devapriya usually hope their child will grow to embody god's delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying divine presence and pleasure.
data.etymology: Devapriya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devapriya total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

vedic_reference.note: Devapriya is a modern Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words देव (Deva, God) and प्रिय (Priya, Lover or Beloved). It is a name that signifies being a lover or devotee of God.

historical_references.reference: The name Devapriya is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deva' meaning god and 'Priya' meaning dear or beloved. It is believed that this name was given to individuals who were considered to be the beloved of the gods.
historical_references.context: The name Devapriya was commonly used during the period of Hindu dynasties like the Guptas and the Pallavas.

historical_references.reference: The name Devapriya is also associated with the Hindu god Vishnu. In some Puranic texts, there is a reference to a sage named Devapriya who was a devotee of Vishnu and was blessed with divine grace.
historical_references.context: The name Devapriya was also used as a personal name for individuals who were devoted to the god Vishnu.
